about.title: The Story of a Historic Mansion in the Heart of Ordu
about.description: Located in the heart of Ordu, this historical mansion stands as a silent witness to the past, built in the early 1900s with the elegant wooden craftsmanship of the Black Sea region. It has witnessed the years of the national struggle from which Zaferimilli District takes its name and once served as one of the gathering places for the local community.
about.description2: With its wooden beams, stone foundation, and hand-carved doors, the mansion carries the spirit of Ordu's traditional architecture into the present day. Once home to a merchant family, it has been carefully restored over the years while preserving its original soul—today welcoming guests as a warm stop that offers both history and flavor. This building is more than just walls; every corner whispers stories of the past. As you sip your coffee or enjoy your meal here, you touch the serenity of an old Ordu morning and the calm of its timeless evenings.
